input.summary: V05 (Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP, contact Prakash) quoted only RM-002 glycerine at 118/kg, RM-008 rosemary extract 20% rosmarinic at 7000/kg (MOQ 100 kg, shelf life 12 months), RM-005 caffeine at 1650/kg if one full lot is lifted (lot size not stated). Freight extra about Rs 9/kg. Terms: 50% advance, balance on delivery, 3-week delivery. Claims 99% OTIF and zero rejection, but no records. Certificates under renewal; COA only after order. Open: RM-002 MOQ and shelf life, RM-005 lot size in kg and shelf life. Knockouts unanswered: SDS, COA before order, leave-on cosmetic suitability. Note RM-008 MOQ 100 kg vs need 28 kg over 6 months. Not yet asked.

input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on your quote (RM-002, RM-005, RM-008)
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

Thank you for your quote for KPC-2026-014. We need the following before we can evaluate it.

Open items on your quoted lines:
1. RM-002 Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade): state the minimum order quantity in kg.
2. RM-002 Glycerin: state the shelf life from date of manufacture and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
3. RM-005 Caffeine anhydrous: you quoted "one full lot". State the size of one lot in kg.
4. RM-005 Caffeine anhydrous: state the shelf life from date of manufacture and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.

Required documents (mandatory before order):
5. Current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each quoted line, including transport hazard class.
6. Certificate of Analysis (COA) from a recent batch for each quoted line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. We need this before we place an order, not after.
7. Confirm that each quoted material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Other information:
8. Which certifications do you hold (ISO 9001, ISO 22716 GMP or equivalent), with expiry dates? Please send the renewal status and expected date for the certificates under renewal.
9. Your rejection rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with the period and basis used. Your reply mentions zero rejection; please provide the supporting records or a summary.
10. Incoterm and delivery point. Confirm whether freight is included. Your reply mentions about Rs 9 per kg extra; state the exact amount and basis.
11. Payment terms. Your reply proposes 50% advance; confirm the terms and any price escalation clause.
12. Can you meet the first need-by date of 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date.
13. RM-008 Rosemary leaf extract: the RFx need is 28 kg over 6 months and your MOQ is 100 kg. Confirm how you would supply this, including whether a single 100 kg lot is acceptable and its shelf life.

Please reply by 8 November 2026, the response deadline in the RFx.

Kind regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
